entities.text: Perumula Pavan vs The State Of Telangana
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
Author: Juvvadi Sridevi
Bench: Juvvadi Sridevi
 Hon'Ble Smt. Justice Juvvadi Sridevi
 I.A.No.2 of 2024
 in/and
 Criminal Petition No.14851 of 2024
Common Order:

This Criminal Petition is filed under Section 528 of BNSS by the petitioners/accused Nos.1 to 5 to quash the proceedings against them in SC POCSO No.6 of 2024 on the file of II Fast Track Special Court for Rape & POCSO Act Cases at Nagarkurnool, registered for the offences punishable under Sections 376, 496, 504, 506 and 201 of IPC.
2.

entities.text: II Fast Track Special Court for Rape & POCSO Act Cases at Nagarkurnool
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
It is submitted by learned counsel appearing for the petitioner as well as the respondent No.2,
that during pendency of the present Criminal Petition, the parties have compromised the matter and accordingly, I.A.No.1 of 2024 has been filed to record the compromise between them and to compound the offences.
3.

Vide order dated 26.12.2024, this Court directed the parties along with their respective counsel to appear before the Secretary, High Court Legal Services Committee, High Court for the State of Telangana, Hyderabad, for identification and to submit a report.

entities.text: High Court Legal Services Committee, High Court for the State of Telangana, Hyderabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
4. Pursuant to the above said direction issued by this Court, the parties have appeared and the Secretary, High Court Legal Services Committee, has identified the parties and submitted a report,
dated 03.01.2025 and the same is placed on record.
5.
In view of the above, I.A.No.2 of 2024 is allowed.

Consequently, this Criminal Petition is allowed and the proceedings against the petitioners/accused Nos.1 to 5 in SC POCSO No.6 of 2024 on the file of II Fast Track Special Court for Rape & POCSO Act Cases at Nagarkurnool, are hereby quashed.

entities.text: II Fast Track Special Court for Rape & POCSO Act Cases at Nagarkurnool
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Miscellaneous applications, if any pending, shall stand closed.
JUVVADI SRIDEVI, J Date: 10.01.2025 Ksk Perumula Pavan vs The State Of Telangana on 10 January, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/75654070/
